milestones.detail: NEET-SS is the entrance exam for DM, MCh and DrNB super-specialty courses. Neurosurgery is in the surgical group, open to those holding MS or DNB in General Surgery by the cut-off date (31 January 2026 for NEET-SS 2025). Registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council is mandatory.
